messages:
Ana P: Hi finance — corpcard declined at the coworking space front desk so I paid the day pass on my personal card. Need to submit for reimbursement and check VAT reclaim.

Amount: GBP 24.00 (posted 2026-05-11)
Receipt: https://files.redwood/receipts/cowork-daypass-0511.jpg
Concur claim started: `EXP-2026-0773`

Sam (Finance): Thanks Ana. Two quick asks: 1) upload the original invoice/receipt (we need vendor name and VAT line if reclaimable). 2) attach the card statement showing the charge. Mark currency as GBP.

If the vendor only gives a basic card slip we will reimburse the full amount but cannot reclaim VAT. If they can provide an invoice with VAT and tax ID, tag me and I'll route to VAT recovery.

Ana P: They only gave a printed receipt with no VAT line. I emailed them asking for a proper invoice but they said they rarely issue them.

Sam (Finance): OK mark the claim GBP 24.00, category `Office - coworking`, note "invoice pending - vendor rarely issues VAT invoices". Submit so manager can approve; we'll process reimbursement as non-reclaimable for now.

Ravi (Manager): Approved 100% - work-related day pass.

ExpenseBot: Expense `EXP-2026-0773` status changed to `Submitted` by Ana P.

Ana P: Uploaded receipt + statement. Tagging Sam for follow-up if they send invoice.

Sam (Finance): Got it. Processing reimbursement within 5 business days. If vendor later supplies VAT invoice we can reopen for reclaim but recovered VAT remains with finance.

Ana P: Thanks!
